title: ORB-SVM : An Innovative Hybrid Framework for Efficient Brain Tumor Detection from MRI Scans
abstract: arXiv:2609.02333v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Brain cancer remains one of the most significant challenges in modern medicine, where the accuracy of early stage diagnosis is a decisive factor in patient survival and treatment efficacy. Although Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is the established gold standard for visualizing neurological structures, the interpretation of these high dimensional scans is often complicated by subjective variability among practitioners and the inherent noise present in complex medical images. translated_title: ORB-SVM：一种用于从MRI扫描中高效检测脑肿瘤的创新混合框架
translated_abstract: 脑癌仍然是现代医学中最重大的挑战之一，早期诊断的准确性是决定患者生存率和治疗效果的关键因素。尽管磁共振成像（MRI）是观察神经系统结构的公认金标准，但由于医生之间的主观判读差异以及复杂医学图像中固有的噪声，对这些高维扫描图像的解读往往变得复杂。虽然当代方法通常依赖高参数的深度学习架构，但此类模型往往涉及高昂的计算成本，并且需要大量数据才能进行有效训练。本研究引入了一种混合框架，利用定向FAST与旋转BRIEF（ORB）算法进行精确的特征提取，并使用支持向量机（SVM）进行分类。所提出的方法实现了大幅度的数据精简……
tldr: 该研究提出了一种结合ORB特征提取算法与SVM分类器的混合框架，以较低的计算成本从MRI扫描中高效检测脑肿瘤，避免了深度学习方法对大量数据和计算资源的依赖。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a hybrid framework combining ORB feature extraction with SVM classification for efficient brain tumor detection from MRI scans, avoiding the heavy computational costs and large data requirements of deep learning approaches.
